paite: Huchi in Solomon in TOUPA' inn ding alamzou vekta a; Solomon in apa David in thil ana latsa tengteng alalut a, dangkasik, dangka-eng, vanzat tengteng Pathian inn a goukoihna ah akoihta hi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Tempul A Laklutna / (1 Kum 8.1-9)
english: Thus all the work that Solomon did for Yahweh’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, even the silver, the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of God’s house.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Israel upate, anam intekte, Israel suante inkuan makaite tengteng, David khopi Zion a kipan TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngtou ding in Jerusalem ah akaikhawm hi.
english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

paite: Huchi in Israel mi tengteng akha sagihna a ankuangluina ah kumpipa kiang ah ahohkhawm uhi.
english: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month.

paite: Israel upate tengteng ahong ua, Levite'n bawm azawng uhi.
english: All the elders of Israel came. The Levites took up the ark.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA bawm leh kihoupihna biakbuk leh puanin a tui-um belsuan siangthou tengteng azawngtou ua; siampu Levite'n azawngtou uhi.
english: They brought up the ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The Levitical priests brought these up.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon leh Israelte omkhawm tengteng akiang a hong kikhawmte bawm ma ah a-omkhawm ua, belam leh bawngtal gen seng vual louh leh sim seng vual louh in akithoih uhi.
english: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled to him were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

paite: Huchi in siampute'n ToUPA thukhun bawm a-omna ding ah alalut ua, insung a biakna mun, Mun Siangthoupen ah, cherubte kha nuai ah.
english: The priests brought in the ark of Yahweh’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.

paite: Cherubte'n bawm omna tung zawn ah akha uh azak gige ua, cherubte'n bawm leh azawnna chiangtawnte akhuh vek uhi.
english: For the cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

paite: Azawnna chiangtawnte asau mahmah a, azawnna chiangtawnte kongte biakna mun mai, Mun Siangthou a kipan in amuh theih a; himahleh polam ah zaw adawk kei: tutan huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside; and it is there to this day.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan apawt ua, TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang a thu akhun lai Mosi in Horeb tang a suangpek nih akoih kia lou ngal huai bawm sung ah bangmah dang a-om kei hi.
english: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when Yahweh made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute Mun Siangthou a kipan a ahong pawttak un, siampu omte tengteng akisiangsak ua, apawl in akibawl tuan kei ua;
heading: TOUPA Thupina
english: When the priests had come out of the holy place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, and didn’t keep their divisions;

paite: Levi lasami tengteng leng avek un, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, atapate uh leh a-unaute uh toh, puanmalngat silh a kivan in dakkhutbette, pekgingte, kaihgingte toh, maitam suahlam sang ah adingh ua, alak uah siampu za-le-sawmnih pengkul mut in a-om lai uhi.
english: also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets);

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, pengkul mutte leh lasa mite'n TOUPA phatna leh kipahthu genna dia atumging uh ging khat bang mai in akiza a; pengkul leh dakkhutbet leh thil tumging toh a-aw uh asuah ua: "Amah lah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a," chi a, TOUPA aphat uleh, meipi in TOUPA' inn akhuhdim meuhmouh hi.
english: when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking Yahweh; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised Yahweh, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!” then the house was filled with a cloud, even Yahweh’s house,

paite: Huchi in meipi ziak in siampute'n nna asem theita kei ua; TOUPA thupina in Pathian inn adim vek hi.
english: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled God’s house.
